children: Thailand's trade deficit widened to USD 2.48 billion in August 2026, up from USD 1.96 billion a year earlier, marking an eleventh straight monthly shortfall but remaining smaller than market forecasts of USD 3.9 billion, as imports rose more than exports.
Imports surged 25.1% yoy, slowing sharply from a 36.7% jump in July and below forecasts of 33%, supported by ongoing government stimulus measures aimed at boosting consumption and investment.
Meanwhile, exports rose 24.3% yoy, accelerating from a 21.6% increase in July but slightly below estimates of 24.9%.

title: Thailand Trade Gap Beats Estimates
